what_it_does: Porting stencil applications to FPGAs using single-source languages (SYCL) may sacrifice productivity or performance; unclear if FPGAs are viable for low-arithmetic-intensity stencils. SYCL stencil implementation: structured and unstructured grids, optimized for CPU (AMD) and FPGA (Intel Stratix 10), benchmarked on both, analyzing resource usage and performance.
